collection.title: Nissan Pulsar 2014 to 2018 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Nissan Pulsar 2014 to 2018 model which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 14" for the passengers side. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have the rear blade for this 500, simply click the Rear Blades tab below.
